items.title: Netflix (NFLX) Following Ad Outlook Cuts Still Looks Undervalued To Some Investors
items.summary: Netflix (NFLX) cut its 2026 ad revenue and free cash flow outlook after delays in rolling out new ad features and partner integrations, putting the streaming group’s newer ad-supported model under closer investor scrutiny. Investors have reacted quickly to the ad guidance cut, with Netflix’s share price falling 11.9% over the past 30 days and down 31.7% year to date, while the 1 year total shareholder return is down 44.1%.
